messages:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — we need to align on entitlements + ingest quotas for the Snow/Databricks vector connector listing. Legal asked for explicit SKU definitions before the marketplace submission. Who can call out constraints from infra/SRE side?
Akash Patel: FYI Snowflake marketplace requires SKU tiers and usage caps. We should map to: free/dev, standard, and enterprise tiers with max ingest qps and monthly vector storage.
Leah Ramos: Security note — enterprise tier must support BYOK (KMS/HSM) and per-tenant data residency controls. Also need to confirm retention window: default 30d with optional 90d for enterprise.
Jordan Kim: Telemetry/telemetry consent question — marketplace listings can't collect PII without opt-in. For telemetry we should send only anonymized metrics. Also: add opt-out flag in the connector config.
Evan S.: To unblock commercial, legal needs suggested SKU names + example contract language for overage billing. Can someone draft a short sample clause? e.g., "Overages billed at X$/GB after Y GB" — we should standardize the unit.
Mia Chen: Good call. Proposed units: ingest GB/day and vector-storage-GB/month. Pricing per 1K embeddings for high-cardinality workloads might be helpful.
Akash Patel: From infra: safe default quotas we can enforce now — dev: 5k requests/day, standard: 500k/day, enterprise: unlimited (but with soft caps and alerting). Enforce at the connector-side + gateway.
Leah Ramos: Also need SLA note for Dedicated customers — 99.9% ingest availability and a runbook for cold-starting vector pushes to avoid dropped batches.
Jordan Kim: Adding example connector config snippet (for ops):
```yaml
connector:
  name: redwood-snow-vector
  telemetry_opt_in: false
  quotas:
    dev: {requests_per_day: 5000, ingest_gb_per_day: 1}
    standard: {requests_per_day: 500000, ingest_gb_per_day: 50}
    enterprise: {soft_limit_requests_per_day: 10000000}
  kms_required: true
```
Evan S.: I'll draft the overage clause and send to legal. Also can someone produce a short table mapping our SKU -> marketplace listing labels? Legal prefers one-line descriptions.
Mia Chen: I'll do labels + one-line descriptions. Drafts due EOD tomorrow.
marketplace-bot: Reminder — marketplace submission checklist: SKU_definition.csv, security_review.pdf, marketing_assets.zip. Link: https://marketplace.partner/docs/submit
Akash Patel: One more infra constraint — some regions have cold-storage costs. We should call out region-specific price multipliers in the marketplace listing (APAC ~= +10%).
Leah Ramos: Agree. Also flag for compliance: EU customers must have rasterization disabled by default for data exfil controls.
Jordan Kim: Decision summary: 1) Units = ingest GB/day + vector-storage-GB/month; 2) Telemetry opt-in default = false; 3) SKU tiers = dev/standard/enterprise with quotas above; 4) Legal to receive sample overage clause from Evan.
Mia Chen: Thanks — I'll file these into the partner PRD and ping product for the marketplace form. @Evan S. please post the clause when ready. :+1:
Evan S.: Will do, posting in this thread when done.
Mia Chen: Closing loop — follow-ups: Mia (labels), Evan (clause), Akash (region multiplier calc), Leah (security checklist). Back on Thursday standup for final sign-off. :rocket:
